spec.rawSql:
SELECT w.window_start, w.window_end, a.cohort_n,
  (SELECT name FROM org_units WHERE id = NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) AS place
FROM report_window('${reporting_month}'::date) w
LEFT JOIN report_adherence('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int, '${include_new}'::boolean) a ON a.is_selected
WHERE '$isAllowed' = '1'

SELECT a.*, b.one_n, b.two_three_n, b.off_n,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'adherence' AND key = 'min_cohort') AS min_cohort,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'adherence' AND key = 'off_protocol_pct') AS off_protocol_pct_line,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'adherence' AND key = 'one_medicine_pct') AS one_medicine_pct_line
FROM report_adherence('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int, '${include_new}'::boolean) a
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT sum(patients_n) FILTER (WHERE bucket_order IN (1, 2)) AS one_n,
    sum(patients_n) FILTER (WHERE bucket_order BETWEEN 3 AND 6) AS two_three_n,
    sum(patients_n) FILTER (WHERE bucket IN ('Other Protocol', 'Non-Protocol')) AS off_n
  FROM report_adherence_buckets('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int, '${include_new}'::boolean)
) b
WHERE a.is_selected AND '$isAllowed' = '1'

SELECT b.bucket, b.bucket_order, b.label, b.patients_n, b.controlled_n, b.controlled_pct
FROM report_adherence_buckets('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int, '${include_new}'::boolean) b
WHERE '$isAllowed' = '1'

spec.description: Each bar counts patients by the medicines on their latest prescription. The end label gives how many have BP under 140/90.
spec.title: Patients by medicine step, and how many are controlled

spec.rawSql:
SELECT a.org_unit_id, a.org_unit_name, a.cohort_n, a.off_protocol_pct, a.one_medicine_pct, b.one_n, b.two_three_n, b.off_n,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'adherence' AND key = 'min_cohort') AS min_cohort,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'adherence' AND key = 'off_protocol_pct') AS off_protocol_pct_line,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'adherence' AND key = 'one_medicine_pct') AS one_medicine_pct_line
FROM report_adherence('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int, '${include_new}'::boolean) a
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT sum(patients_n) FILTER (WHERE bucket_order IN (1, 2)) AS one_n,
    sum(patients_n) FILTER (WHERE bucket_order BETWEEN 3 AND 6) AS two_three_n,
    sum(patients_n) FILTER (WHERE bucket IN ('Other Protocol', 'Non-Protocol')) AS off_n
  FROM report_adherence_buckets('${reporting_month}'::date, a.org_unit_id, '${include_new}'::boolean)
) b
WHERE a.flag AND a.level >= 3 AND '$isAllowed' = '1'

WITH fl AS (
  SELECT org_unit_id, json_agg(json_build_object('report', report, 'flag_reason', flag_reason, 'patients_n', patients_n)
           ORDER BY report)::text AS flags_json
  FROM report_flags('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int) GROUP BY org_unit_id
)
SELECT a.*, b.one_n, b.two_three_n, b.off_n,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'adherence' AND key = 'min_cohort') AS min_cohort,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'adherence' AND key = 'off_protocol_pct') AS off_protocol_pct_line,
  (SELECT value FROM report_flag_thresholds WHERE report = 'adherence' AND key = 'one_medicine_pct') AS one_medicine_pct_line,
  fl.flags_json
FROM report_adherence('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(NULLIF(TRIM('${org_unit}'), ''), '0')::int, '${include_new}'::boolean) a
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT sum(patients_n) FILTER (WHERE bucket_order IN (1, 2)) AS one_n,
    sum(patients_n) FILTER (WHERE bucket_order BETWEEN 3 AND 6) AS two_three_n,
    sum(patients_n) FILTER (WHERE bucket IN ('Other Protocol', 'Non-Protocol')) AS off_n
  FROM report_adherence_buckets('${reporting_month}'::date, NULLIF(a.org_unit_id, 0), '${include_new}'::boolean)
) b
LEFT JOIN fl ON fl.org_unit_id = a.org_unit_id
WHERE '$isAllowed' = '1'

options.content: How this is worked out. Each patient's latest prescription in the last 90 days is placed on a six-step ladder of medicines and doses. Off protocol counts other protocol combinations and medicines outside the protocol. Controlled means BP under 140/90 at that visit. 'Patients counted' above changes who is included.
